newsitem.title: USA: U.S. inflation well contained --Fed's Lindsey.
newsitem.headline: U.S. inflation well contained --Fed's Lindsey.

text.p: U.S. inflation is well contained, Federal Reserve Governor Lawrence Lindsey said on Thursday.
"We have a generally contained inflation situation," Lindsey told reporters after participating in a conference at the Brookings Institution.

He acknowledged that rising energy prices do have an impact on inflation but he said that the effect was limited. "It is a part of the inflation picture and it does matter ... to a small extent," Lindsey said.
